text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and repeated topic sentences","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured around an introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion with explicit controlling ideas."},{"evidence":"several connected paragraphs with transitions like \"On the other hand\" and \"Otherwise\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The writing uses more discourse markers to link ideas and signal how points relate to one another."},{"evidence":"\"benefits,\" \"successful,\" \"opportunities,\" \"experiences,\" \"obstacles\"","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"The essay uses a broader range of topic-appropriate, school-like vocabulary to express abstract ideas."},{"evidence":"\"people can face their obstacles, it gives them many opportunities and experiences to learn\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops its claim with more elaboration and supporting explanation rather than brief personal examples alone."},{"evidence":"longer, multi-clause sentences with several subordinate ideas","quality":"syntactic complexity","description":"The writing shows more control of complex sentence structures and combines ideas more elaborately."},{"evidence":"mostly understandable word choice despite errors","quality":"overall control","description":"The essay maintains clearer meaning across the piece and is easier to follow despite grammatical mistakes."}]}
